status_line: The preview is drawn on the graphics card whenever it can be: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (DiscreteGpu), driver NVIDIA 610.88, Vulkan, 16.8 GB of its own memory. Exports are still drawn on the CPU. A frame the card cannot draw is drawn on the CPU, and the picture's label says so.
picture_is: preview, every k-th pixel; the cpu-vs-card difference uses the full frame
